article.title: Meta acknowledges the reduced reach of Lula’s profiles
article.author: Editor
article.content: The company, which controls WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram, claims that “technical issues” affected the reach of Lula’s presidential campaign, and rejects accusations of favoring Flávio Bolsonaro. The post Meta acknowledges the reduced reach of Lula’s profiles appeared first on MR Online .
